count_scope: Source/fixture-derived expected128bit read work;NOT actual bus acceptance counts,elapsed-time ratio,FPGA speedup or completed RTL proof.

budget.formula: Tcompile + Tload + sum(Tfull_i for6calls) + Tpreview_error + sum(Tearly_i for5calls) +24*Tdump + Tdrain + Tmargin
measurements_missing: Actual complete normal-memory full call duration
budget.six_hour_assessment: Insufficient empirical basis;not a justified whole-suite estimate

term_definitions.Tfull_i: DUT start-to-done host walltime for stages0-4; excludes memory-image exports
term_definitions.Tpreview_error: DUT start-to-done walltime for full preview/error path;excludes exports
term_definitions.Tdump: Mean host walltime to export one complete80592beat memory image
term_definitions.alternative: If measuring end-to-end case walltime including exports, sum those12case durations and do not add24*Tdump again. None of these unknown durations is inferred from physical200MHz.

terminal_classification.numeric_failure: Only actual assertion/mismatch or independent array/control/address rejection proves numeric/protocol failure;inspect cause
terminal_classification.success: Tool return alone is not independent12case acceptance

scope_unchanged: All12persistent cases retained;no subset substituted;no EDA/restart/STOP/guard change/timer restoration
